name: Sim Chain Names
description: Hidden fixture: the chain brick with names on, two celebrations that travel and come home signed (scripts/simulate-chain-names.js).

chain-start.prompt: Write one thing you did this month that you are proud of.

pass.prompt: Read what your classmate is proud of. Add a line celebrating it.

pass-2.prompt: Read the pride and the first celebration. Add a celebration of your own.

wrap.message: Everyone got two cheers. Keep them.
